reporting-org.narrative: European Bank for Reconstruction and Development

description.narrative: The project involves a long-term senior loan of up to EUR 50 million to Volyn West Wind-2 LLC and Volyn West Wind-3 LLC (jointly referred to as the "Borrowers" or the "Client"), special purpose vehicles incorporated in Ukraine. The loan will be a part of a senior secured debt financing to be provided by a consortium of development financial institutions including the EBRD, IFC, BSTDB (together, the "Lenders"), to finance the construction and operation of a 189 MW wind power plant ("WPP") in Ukraine (the "Project"). The Project will benefit from a guarantee and technical assistance ("TA") funds under the EU's Ukraine Investment Framework ("UIF") Hi-Bar programme. The Borrowers are majority-owned by VI.AN Holding, which forms part of OKKO Group AG ("OKKO Group"). The Project will strengthen Ukraine's energy resilience by constructing a 189 MW wind power plant. With significant power generation capacity of Ukraine destroyed because of the war, this investment is crucial to address the severe energy shortfall, support Ukraine's decarbonisation goals, and boost the private sector's role in further development of the renewable energy sector in the country.
